value.title: docs/api Java examples compile against the API of the current wave (wave 4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The root `build.gradle` puts the `NaruServe-api` main classes on the root test suite's test classpath (for example `testImplementation project(':NaruServe-api')`) while keeping the wave 1 root test conventions (JUnit 4, `gradleTestKit()`, the existing `test` task dependencies and system properties). [I-009; wave decision: docs examples]
The root test `src/test/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/docs/DocsExamplesCompileTest.java` extracts every ```java fenced block of every `docs/api/*.md` file. [I-009; wave decision: docs examples]

The test compiles a block that declares a top-level type as its own compilation unit and places any other block in a method template that declares `throws Exception`, both with the fixed imports `com.snoworca.naruserve.*`, `com.snoworca.naruserve.routing.*`, `com.snoworca.naruserve.spi.*`, `java.util.*`, `java.util.concurrent.*` and `java.io.*`, where the template has `app` (`RestApp`), `req` (`Request`) and `res` (`Response`) as fields in scope and declares the stub handlers and stub values the docs name (such as `getUser`, `id`, `user`, `ctx`, `auth`, `myAdapter` or `myCodec`); compilation runs in process through `javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler()` with the test runtime classpath, using `--release 8` when the in-process compiler supports it, or `-source 8 -target 8` on a Java 8 compiler against its actual Java 8 platform classes, and a compilation error or a missing system compiler fails the test. [I-009; wave decision: docs examples] Decision: a non-type block is wrapped in `class DocExampleN` with fields `app`, `req` and `res` and stub `RouteHandler` fields for the handler names the docs use, inside `void example() throws Exception`; a failure names each block's file, ordinal and diagnostics. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-6 SDS-AC-7] [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-6 SDS-AC-8] Decision: the template also declares the stub fields `ctx` (`ApplicationContext`), `auth` (`Middleware`), `myAdapter` (`HttpAdapter`) and `myCodec` (`JsonCodec`). [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-4-10 SDS-AC-11]

A block is skipped only when it is on an explicit list kept in the test whose entry names the file, the block (its ordinal among the file's ```java blocks or its first line) and one reason: a call to a later-wave method (named), an illustrative copy of an existing type declaration (such as `Method` or `RouteHandler`), a type of a later wave or of a library absent from the root test classpath (named, such as Gson `@SerializedName` or `UploadFile`), or an app-defined example type the block assumes (named, such as `UserService` or `Database`). [I-009; wave decision: docs examples] Decision: the block selector is an ordinal such as `#3` or the block's first line. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-6 SDS-AC-9]
A ```java fence in `docs/api` that holds JavaScript is relabelled ```js. [I-009; wave decision: docs examples]

The test fails when a skip-list entry no longer matches any block of its file, so no stale skip remains. [I-009; wave decision: docs examples] `DocsExamplesCompileTest` is re-pointed to this requirement.

The blocks of `docs/api/response.md` and `docs/api/routing.md` that call only wave 3 methods are compiled, not skipped: the test asserts that at least one block of each of these two files was compiled. [I-009; wave decision: docs examples]

value.requirement: The system shall compile, in the root test suite, every ```java block of `docs/api/*.md` whose methods and types exist at the merge of the current wave, against the `NaruServe-api` main classes, skipping only blocks on an explicit, non-stale skip list (I-008, I-009).
